verdict.rationale: Batch or bulk processing is a fair question for an AI inference SDK and hosted API, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only single-request generation, streaming, transcription and tool calling, with no batch or bulk endpoint. The multi-file download progress fields (currentFileIndex, totalFiles) cover fetching a model's files, an adjacent feature that does not let a user act on many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
